selection_objective: Maximum arithmetic mean five-session raw-price label less declared round-trip cost proxy, measured only in eligible training episodes; ties use selection_candidates order. Cash is eligible with zero score.
decision: At completed close t, select highest positive close[t]/close[t-lookback]-1; ties alphabetically by asset. Otherwise cash. Asset set is fixed ex ante for this engineering experiment.
episode_anchor: First eligible session 2015-01-02; global session offset modulo five equals zero. An episode ending at t+6 and its successor entering at t+6 share the same open boundary.
price_convention: Unadjusted bundled LEAN integer prices divided by 10000. Open-to-open raw price labels only; cash distributions, financing, liquidity, execution and broker fees are NOT modeled. Cost is an illustrative per-episode fully-invested 20-basis-point deduction, proportional to total allocated weight; cash has zero cost. No compounding, cash account, position or simulated P&L claim.
corporate_action_policy: Reject nonconstant split factors or ticker changes whose effective factor/map interval overlaps 2014-01-02 through 2021-03-31. Dividend-related price-factor changes are retained as an explicit raw-price limitation.
selection_boundary: All training label exit dates must be strictly before first evaluation decision date. Reserved selection uses exactly the last 252 development decision sessions before a six-session exclusion. All asset rows at a session remain grouped. Selections written exclusively before evaluation labels are materialized.
embargo: No future-side training in this strictly chronological design, so no additional post-evaluation embargo. The six-session exclusion follows the declared label horizon; exact intervals are checked independently. This does not guarantee statistical independence.
reserved_policy: One reserved 2021Q1 evaluation after frozen selection; all five candidate diagnostics retained, no retuning or automatic promotion. Later use for selection makes this segment development evidence. Public bundled data is not demonstrated globally unseen.
incomplete_labels: Retain incomplete episode records as censored when exit falls beyond the development_end or reserved_end segment boundary; do not fill, infer or include them in scoring. Development evaluation labels may extend beyond an individual 63-session fold while remaining within the development segment; future outcomes never enter an earlier selection.
scope: Chronological engineering control on three selected ETFs; no catalyst, +200% mover, PIT universe, original observation-time or alpha acceptance.
